notablePrerequisites:
Luxior attached to Xenagos.
You control at least five creatures.
description:
Activate Xenagos's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding at least five {R/G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Xenagos.
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Xenagos.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat while activating Xenagos's second loyalty ability instead in step 1, and you may activate Emiel any number of times.
